name: qr-thumbnail-demo
description: Proof of concept: a Trace-It QR code placed inside a publisher's article thumbnail from their article ID alone, with no read or write access to their data or S3.

scripts.lint:php: node -e "const{execFileSync}=require('child_process'),fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');let bad=0;const walk=d=>fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e=>e.isDirectory()?(e.name==='vendor'?[]:walk(p.join(d,e.name))):e.name.endsWith('.php')?[p.join(d,e.name)]:[]);for(const f of walk('php')){try{execFileSync('php',['-l',f],{stdio:'pipe'});console.log('  ok   '+f)}catch(e){bad++;console.log('  FAIL '+f);console.log(String(e.stdout||e.message))}}process.exit(bad?1:0)"
